name: Claude

electron.claim: Installed Claude 1.46388.4 includes Electron Framework 42.10.0. Read-only metadata and strict signature/full-bundle integrity match the latest official Developer Mode CSS trial and final cleanup.

popularity.claim: Anthropic reported over 300,000 business customers on 2025-09-02. This is company-wide adoption, not desktop installs.

caveats: Official Developer Mode requires manual opt-in; the documented mode remains enabled as persistent setup. The debugger listener was closed separately after the trials.
Three CSS proofs across two app processes: two on 1.46388.3 and one on installed 1.46388.4. Each controller borrowed an existing process/profile, removed its stylesheet, and disconnected.
Fixed main-process JavaScript and fixed read-only renderer appearance checks were verified for cosmetic CSS only. General-purpose extension JavaScript remains unverified.
